title: Diagnostic Fee Repaid on a Coverage Re-decision — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
**Rule.** For a coverage re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the diagnostic fee repaid is the part of it the holder was left to pay. The fee is the repaired line's diagnostic fee. The credit is any credit the store gave by applying that fee to the repair, as recorded in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Store's credit of the repaired line's diagnostic fee | Repaid |
|---|---|
| In part | the uncredited part |
| In full | nothing |
| None | the whole fee |

**Worked (hypothetical fee of 112.00).** A credit of 12.00 leaves 100.00 repaid. A credit of 112.00 leaves 0.00. No credit leaves 112.00.
